description: This source file defines a Swift structure and an enum related to sanitizing and validating environment variables and overrides, specifically for host environment security policies. It includes functionality for filtering, normalizing, and inspecting environment variable overrides, with special handling for certain keys and prefixes.

classes.name: HostEnvOverrideDiagnostics
classes.description: A simple data structure to hold diagnostics information about blocked and invalid environment variable overrides.

methods.name: inspectOverrides
methods.description: Inspects provided environment variable overrides for security, returning diagnostics about blocked and invalid keys.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variables and optional overrides by filtering out blocked or invalid keys, with optional shell wrapper considerations.
